description: Keep this repo's automerges as reviewable PRs. A top-level automergeType is
inert here: the preset sets automergeType per updateType in packageRules,
which override top-level config, so the override must also be a packageRule.
Keep Renovate's own minor and patch bumps in one branch. Must stay in a rule
without matchUpdateTypes — separateMinorPatch is resolved before the update
type is known, and Renovate rejects combining the two.
Self-update Renovate tooling. Restricted to minor/patch: the only match here
is renovatebot/pre-commit-hooks, which provides this repo's only validator,
and a major bump can rename or drop the hook id. Majors get a review.
